description:
After a data migration, the demodb travel agency database contains orphan vertices — Profiles and Hotels with no connecting edges (no friendships, stays, reviews, orders, etc.). Your job is to find all orphan vertices in the Profiles and Hotels classes, delete them, and produce an audit report.

Connect to demodb in OrientDB Studio (http://localhost:2480/studio/index.html). Server credentials: root / GymAnything123! — Database credentials: admin / admin.

1. Find all Profiles with no edges (hint: vertices where bothE().size() = 0)
2. Find all Hotels with no edges
3. Delete all orphan Profile and Hotel vertices
4. Save an audit report to ~/orientdb_audit_report.txt with this exact format:
   Line 1: Orphan Profiles Found: <number>
   Line 2: Orphan Hotels Found: <number>
   Line 3: Total Orphans Deleted: <number>
   Then a blank line, followed by the deleted orphan profile emails (one per line)
   Then a blank line, followed by the deleted orphan hotel names (one per line)

IMPORTANT: Only delete vertices that have ZERO edges. Do NOT delete any vertex that has at least one edge connection.
